title: R’ Chagga of Tzippori
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: So Seder HaDorot cites from Shekalim, chapter 1, but Hyman says he has not found it there. The text Hyman uses reads: “Rabbi Huna Rabbah of Tzippori said: Rabbi Chanina instituted in Tzippori.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 1:1 fully writes Rabbi Chuna Rabbah of Tzippori, supporting Rabbi Huna for ר״ה in this occurrence. Hyman’s nonmatch for Chagga is his observation, not a new exhaustive finding.

The supplied heading’s ר׳ is retained as R’ because the cited Jerusalem Talmud passage names Rabbi Chuna, rather than Chagga. Hyman’s report of Seder HaDorot and his failure to find Chagga remain attributed observations; no identification of the two names is asserted.
